verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a virtual mailbox service, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows APIs that sync mail to other tools and cloud access to digital copies. Nothing documents a bulk export of all data, open export formats, or an offboarding path, and APIs are developer building blocks rather than a full-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
